title: Familiensache? Die Korrespondenz der Kaiserin Eleonora Magdalena (1655–1720)
institution: Institut für die Erforschung der Habsburgermonarchie und des Balkanraumes (IHB) and Austrian Centre for Digital Humanities, Österreichische Akademie der Wissenschaften (FWF project P 34651; ed. Katrin Keller, Ines Peper, Anna Spitzbart, Dorota Vargová)
author: Eleonora Magdalena von Pfalz-Neuburg
period: 1677-1720 (letters sent by and to the empress)
region: Habsburg lands and the Holy Roman Empire
license_note: The imprint puts the site and its contents under CC BY 4.0 unless marked otherwise; the licence element in each TEI header only says 'copyright'.
notes: Digital edition of the letters of Empress Eleonora Magdalena of Pfalz-Neuburg (wife of Leopold I) with transcriptions, facsimiles, indexes, a calendar and PDF export; the TEI file of each letter is served at the letter's address with .xml instead of .html, and the working files are in the project's GitHub repository. Of the 1,605 letters listed in the edition's CMIF file of 24 September 2026, 472 date from 1701 to 1716. Language: German in nearly all letters (a few in other languages). Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
